text.arabic_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

words.gloss_range: coordinating continuation at the ayah opening
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation, not as an isolated restart. It carries the preceding description of the left-hand group into the report of their own speech, so the quoted denial becomes another disclosure of the same profile. Because the particle is bound onto the following past frame in recitation, the boundary link and the habitual-speech frame are heard together.

topics.headline: opening connector carries the prior indictment forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 56:47 continues the prior profile rather than beginning a detached quotation scene.
topics.reason: The QAC conjunction tag and the attachment analysis of the ayah as a continued reporting frame support the CRITICAL claim that the opening particle carries the previous description into the quotation.

topics.headline: bound onset fuses link and frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector is not only logical; its bound sound makes the transition into the habitual frame immediate.
topics.reason: The particle is tokenized separately but functions as a proclitic before the following verb, preserving the CRITICAL surface-and-sound observation.

words.gloss_range: past auxiliary frame for repeated saying by the prior group
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and state-framing; here the local surface is an auxiliary frame, with the becoming pressure visible only through the later same-root echo

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: quote-internal same-root copular form marking the speakers' claimed material state

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) frames the speech as a settled past habit: they used to say this, not merely once said it. Its plural suffix keeps the prior left-hand group as the reported speakers before the quotation turns into first-person speech. The same root later returns in {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}), so the ayah makes one state-root carry both their social habit and their imagined becoming dust, while the local grammar of {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) remains auxiliary rather than a full formation verb. That state-language also belongs to the surah's classificatory thread: what they were doing here is part of the pattern by which groups and outcomes are named later (56:86-92).

topics.headline: past auxiliary makes denial habitual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that resurrection denial is profiled as an entrenched repeated habit, not a one-time outburst.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect copular or auxiliary verb, and attachment evidence makes the following imperfect saying clause its predicate.

topics.headline: plural suffix keeps the prior group in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices who is speaking: the prior third-person group carries into the quoted first-person objection without a new noun phrase.
topics.reason: The attachment and referent evidence strongly link the 3mp agreement to the already established group, while the quote-internal forms later shift to first person.

topics.headline: same root frames habit, then imagined becoming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local root echo: the same state-root first marks what they habitually were doing, then what they claim they became.
topics.reason: The echo is locally real, but V4 branch variety does not make formation derivatives active in {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}); the surviving payoff is the auxiliary-to-copular same-root shift.

topics.headline: state language belongs to a broader denial field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the habitual frame participates in a wider state-classification and resurrection-denial field in the surah.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles show the same root-form class is common in state framing, and the CRITICAL rows tie this local instance to the ayah's denial configuration.

words.gloss_range: they say or keep saying inside a past habitual frame
words.root_gloss_range: saying and utterance; here direct owned speech, not causative or imposed speech
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqūlūna}}) supplies the action inside the past frame: they kept saying the denial. The imperfect form and plural ending make the objection a collective habit, while the Form I speech root assigns the utterance to them rather than making it imposed speech. Structurally, the verb opens the direct quotation that follows; pragmatically, it lets their own rhetorical question perform the denial. The speech act also belongs to a recurring resurrection-objection formula (17:49, 23:82, 37:16) and prepares the later commanded answer (56:49).

topics.headline: imperfect speech verb makes denial repeated and owned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is voiced as a repeated collective practice, not a private or isolated thought.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indicative imperfect 3mp verb under the past auxiliary frame, and the attachment evidence makes it the predicate of the preceding auxiliary.

topics.headline: speech verb opens a quotation that performs rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah records the deniers' own wording as evidence, and that the quoted question functions as rejection.
topics.reason: The quote is syntactically forced as the complement of the speech verb, and the interrogative content is constrained by the denial frame.

topics.headline: Form I selects direct utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording makes the deniers responsible speakers, while broader causative and disputational root branches stay outside the local form.
topics.reason: The local Form I imperfect supports direct saying; other root-family derivatives are useful contrast but do not replace the selected local sense.

topics.headline: speech root cues a recurring resurrection objection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this saying belongs to a recognizable resurrection-denial speech formula, with parallels at 17:49, 23:82, and 37:16.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallel references, and contextual co-occurrence supports saying plus raisedness as a recurring objection configuration.

words.gloss_range: interrogative temporal-conditional opening: when or if, under denial-force question

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second interrogative opening that begins the apodosis

words.prose: {{ar:أَئِذَا}} ({{tr:a-idhā}}) starts the quoted objection by turning time into a condition under question. The word gathers death and decomposition into the protasis, delaying the main claim until the later emphatic question. Its initial hamza makes the quotation begin with an audible interrogative catch, and the matching later hamza in {{ar:أَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:a-innā}}) brackets condition and outcome.

topics.headline: the opening question makes death the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers are not asking about time alone; they build a condition from death, dust, and bones before challenging resurrection.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as interrogative plus temporal adverb, and attachment evidence links the span beginning here as the condition for the final raised predicate.

topics.headline: first hamza opens the double-question architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the architecture of denial: one question opens over the condition and the second opens over the raisedness claim.
topics.reason: The two interrogative openings are both present in the local surface and are syntactically distributed between protasis and apodosis.

topics.headline: hamza launch makes formulaic disbelief audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted denial begins with an audible question onset that cues a familiar resurrection-objection formula.
topics.reason: The particle's interrogative surface is locally present; the CRITICAL rows preserve the formulaic echo without letting it override the local syntactic condition.

words.gloss_range: we died; completed death inside the quoted condition
words.root_gloss_range: death, lifelessness, and cessation; here completed dying by the quoted speakers, with barren-earth imagery only as contextual coloring near dust
words.prose: {{ar:مِتْنَا}} ({{tr:mitnā}}) is the first lexical event inside the condition. Its perfect form treats death as already completed in the speakers' hypothesis, while the first-person plural suffix makes them include themselves in the premise they use against resurrection. The word begins the movement from death to dust and bones, and it stands opposite the final passive raised predicate. Variant vowel traditions keep the death verb as a recitational pressure point, but they do not change the local condition or its speakers. The same-surah echo later reframes their personal we died as death under divine apportioning (56:60).

topics.headline: perfect verb concedes completed death
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers grant completed death and place themselves inside that condition before disputing what comes after.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect 1cp verb, and attachment evidence keeps the first-person subject quote-internal.

topics.headline: death begins the reversal axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's core polarity: death is accepted as cessation, while raisedness is the reversal they mock.
topics.reason: The local sequence and co-occurrence evidence support the death-to-raising contrast without requiring a nonlocal branch replacement.

topics.headline: death launches the material sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that death is not the whole argument; it opens a staged move from event to dust and bones.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the following becoming clause with the death verb inside the same condition.

topics.headline: variant vowel and later decree echo qualify the death word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the death verb has a sensitive recited vowel profile and is later reframed in the surah by death as divine decree at 56:60.
topics.reason: The qiraat and same-surah echo are meaningful apparatus, but the canonical local parse remains a perfect first-person death verb in the quote.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle linking death to the becoming-dust clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: copular state clause coordinated with the death verb

words.prose: This {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps death and becoming dust coordinated inside one condition. It does not collapse the two steps: the speakers first name completed death, then add the state they claim follows from it. Because the particle is bound to {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}), the protasis stays open and pivots from event verb to copular material state.

topics.headline: connector keeps death and decomposition in one condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dust-and-bones clause remains inside the same conditional objection as the death verb.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the following copular clause with the death verb inside the conditional frame.

topics.headline: the particle separates event from resultant state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-step argument: dying is an event, while becoming dust and bones is the material state the deniers add to make return seem impossible.
topics.reason: The bound conjunction before the copula preserves both coordination and distinction between the death event and the material state clause.

words.gloss_range: we were or became, as a copular state predicate inside the quotation
words.root_gloss_range: being and becoming; here a copular state predication assigning dust and bones to the speakers
words.prose: {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) is the hinge from dying to material self-description. It governs the accusative predicates dust and bones together, so the speakers say not merely that dust exists after them but that this is what they became. The first-person suffix keeps the same quoted we through death, becoming, and later raisedness. The same-root echo with {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) is real, but its payoff is the shift from narrator's habitual frame to the speakers' claimed material state.

topics.headline: copula makes dust and bones their claimed state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dust and bones are grammatical predicates of the speakers, not loose scenery around death.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks dust as the accusative predicate of the copula and bones as coordinated with it.

topics.headline: first-person suffix carries the speakers into decomposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same we who died also claim to become dust and bones, keeping the objection self-involving.
topics.reason: The 1cp agreement is quote-internal and continues the same speaker group from the preceding death verb.

topics.headline: same root shifts from habit frame to becoming-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local wordplay: one state-root moves from the narrator's report of what they used to say to the speakers' claim about what they became.
topics.reason: The same-root echo survives, while broader formation-derivative claims are narrowed to the local auxiliary-versus-copular function shift.

topics.headline: becoming clause supplies the formula's material premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the copular clause is the middle beat that turns death into the material premise for denying raisedness.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and local syntax support the becoming-plus-dust-and-bones configuration as the quote's material premise.

words.gloss_range: dust or earth-matter as an indefinite accusative predicate
words.root_gloss_range: dust, ground-level material, and related poverty or abundance images; here concrete dust is selected, with nonlocal abundance imagery only as ironic root-family pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تُرَابًۭا}} ({{tr:turāban}}) is the first material predicate after the copula. Its accusative case makes dust what the speakers say they became, and its indefinite mass-like form generalizes them into unbounded earth-matter. Paired with {{ar:عِظَٰمًا}} ({{tr:ʿiẓāman}}), it gives the diffuse pole of the decomposition argument; the matching tanwīn sound helps the two predicates form one audible material unit. Broader root-family images of lowliness and abundance remain background pressure, while the local selected sense is concrete dust. The deniers cite dust as impossibility evidence even though the wider creation-return field also presents dust as origin material (3:59, 18:37, 22:5, 30:20, 35:11, 40:67).

topics.headline: accusative dust names the claimed resultant state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dust is not a loose object; it is the state the speakers predicate of themselves.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as an accusative predicate of the preceding copula.

topics.headline: dust supplies the diffuse pole of decomposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the objection spans matter types: diffuse dust and structured bones together make the premise feel exhaustive.
topics.reason: The two nouns share predicate status under the same copular frame, and contextual evidence links dust and bones in the resurrection-denial field.

topics.headline: local sense is concrete dust, with root-family pressure narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ground-level concreteness of the word, while poverty and abundance associations remain qualifying background rather than the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The concrete noun and death frame select dust or earth-matter; derivative poverty and abundance images color but do not govern the local predicate.

topics.headline: dust echoes origin-return arguments and sounds with bones
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers cite dust as impossibility evidence even though the wider scriptural field also uses dust as origin material, and the local tanwīn cadence binds dust to bones.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete creation-from-dust references and local sound evidence; both are compatible with the selected concrete sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding bones as the second material predicate
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds bones to dust under the same copular frame. It prevents the second material noun from being a mere gloss on dust and instead makes a coordinated pair: diffuse matter plus skeletal structure. The short connector also gives the pair a small rhythmic hinge between two matching accusative endings.

topics.headline: connector makes bones a second predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bones are added as a distinct coordinated state, not as an explanation of dust.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks bones as coordinated with dust as a second predicate after the copula.

topics.headline: light hinge completes the material pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction expands the matter field from dust to bones and lets the two nouns sound balanced.
topics.reason: The particle links the two material nouns and preserves the local ordered-pair and cadence observations.

words.root_gloss_range: bone, skeletal support, and greatness or magnitude branches; here the concrete bone sense is selected, while the prior greatness echo remains a boundary resonance
words.prose: {{ar:عِظَٰمًا}} ({{tr:ʿiẓāman}}) completes the material premise as a second accusative predicate. Unlike the mass-like dust, it is plural and concrete, presenting dispersed skeletal parts as the hard remnant of the body. The word closes the protasis just before the raisedness question and carries a paired -an cadence with {{ar:تُرَابًۭا}} ({{tr:turāban}}). It also belongs to a repeated bone-objection formula (17:49, 17:98, 23:82, 36:78, 37:16, 37:53, 79:11). The word also carries a boundary echo: the prior ayah spoke of great sin (56:46), and here the same root-family sound shifts into bones, turning moral magnitude into the material language of the deniers' objection without making the senses identical.

topics.headline: bones share the accusative predicate frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bones are what the speakers say they became, parallel to dust under the same copular frame.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as a second accusative predicate coordinated with dust.

topics.headline: plural bones give the structured pole of decomposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the objection includes not only diffuse matter but also the body's hard remaining framework.
topics.reason: The concrete plural noun and paired dust context support the skeletal-remnant sense.

topics.headline: same root-family sound shifts from greatness to bones
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary resonance: the prior great sin is followed by a concrete bone word from the same root family, exposing the denial through a sound-linked sense shift.
topics.reason: The concrete bone sense remains local; abstract greatness is preserved as boundary echo and root-family contrast, not as the selected meaning of this noun.

topics.headline: bones close the protasis in a familiar objection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bones are the final material item before the raisedness question and echo a repeated resurrection-denial formula (17:49, 17:98, 23:82, 36:78, 37:16, 37:53, 79:11).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallel references, and the local order places bones at the close of the protasis.

words.gloss_range: interrogative hamza plus emphatic particle and first-person plural subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final passive participial predicate where the apodosis lands

words.prose: {{ar:أَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:a-innā}}) begins the answer-slot to the condition and turns an emphatic subject claim into an incredulous question. The hamza questions while the emphatic particle asserts, so the speakers quote certainty in order to mock it. The attached first-person plural keeps the same we from death and becoming into the disputed raisedness. Variant hamza treatments show a real recitational pressure point, but the local clause still supplies the apodosis whose predicate lands at {{ar:مَبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:mabʿūthūna}}).

topics.headline: hamza over assertion turns certainty into mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers place an emphatic claim under question, making asserted raisedness the target of disbelief.
topics.reason: QAC identifies interrogative hamza plus emphatic particle and suffix, while translation support flags the incredulous interrogative force.

topics.headline: attached subject keeps the same we in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same quoted speakers carry themselves through dying, becoming, and being raised.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the suffix as the governed subject of the particle and links it to the quote-internal speaker chain.

topics.headline: second interrogative opens the apodosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote separates condition from outcome: the first question begins with death, and this second opening targets raisedness.
topics.reason: The attachment analysis marks this clause as the apodosis to the earlier condition, and the surface repeats the interrogative opening.

topics.headline: variant readings expose sound pressure without changing the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that adjacent hamza realization is a sensitive recitational site, while the resurrection predicate remains the same disputed claim.
topics.reason: Accepted variant articulation is useful evidence for recitational pressure, but it does not replace the canonical local relation between subject and predicate.

topics.headline: emphatic structure focuses the predicate on us
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputed claim is not abstract resurrection but whether we ourselves are the ones to be raised.
topics.reason: The subject suffix and predicate relation keep the claim focused on the quoted speakers' own raised status.

words.gloss_range: emphatic prefix attached to the final predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) attaches directly to the final passive participle and intensifies the predicate after the emphatic particle. The result is not a bare raisedness claim but raisedness dressed in certainty while the whole clause remains under incredulous question. Its bound position makes the certainty-marker audible at the very onset of the closing predicate.

topics.headline: emphatic prefix loads the final predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers are questioning an emphatically framed claim, not a neutral predicate.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as an emphatic prefix, and attachment evidence places the following participle as the predicate of the emphatic subject clause.

topics.headline: bound prefix fuses certainty to raisedness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis is not detachable from the final word; it is heard as part of the predicate's landing.
topics.reason: The proclitic particle is graphically and phonologically attached to the passive participle, preserving the CRITICAL surface cue.

words.gloss_range: raised ones; passive participial predicate of the emphatic question
words.root_gloss_range: raising, rousing, dispatching, and sending forth; here passive raised status is selected, with sending-forth pressure narrowed to the root-family background of resurrection

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic prefix attached to the final predicate

words.prose: {{ar:مَبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:mabʿūthūna}}) is the final predicate and the answer-slot to the whole condition. As a passive participle, it makes the speakers affected recipients of raising rather than agents who raise themselves, and as a plural nominative predicate it classifies them as raised ones. The word reverses the death-and-decomposition sequence and closes the ayah on the disputed status itself. The root's sending-forth range gives resurrection purposeful pressure, but the local form narrows that range to passive raisedness, intensified by the preceding {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) and echoed in recurring denial formulas (17:49, 23:82, 37:16). Its final long -ūna cadence holds the questioned raisedness at the stop, completing the opening question that began at {{ar:أَئِذَا}} ({{tr:a-idhā}}).

topics.headline: passive participle makes them affected raised ones
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputed raising is something done to the speakers, not an action they perform.
topics.reason: QAC marks a passive participle, and the attachment evidence places it as the predicate of the emphatic subject clause.

topics.headline: plural nominative predicate classifies the quoted we
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word names a resulting status of the speakers: raised ones.
topics.reason: The form agrees with the first-person plural subject and functions as the predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: final predicate reverses death, dust, and bones
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word gathers the whole preceding condition and states the reversal they reject.
topics.reason: The adverbial condition beginning at the earlier interrogative scopes over this predicate, making it the structural answer-slot for death and decomposition.

topics.headline: sending-forth range colors but does not override passive resurrection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that raisedness is not bare animation; the root family carries rousing and sending-forth pressure, while the local passive participle keeps raised status primary.
topics.reason: The broader root range is real in V4, but formal evidence narrows the local sense to passive participial raisedness rather than repeated dispatch or self-emergence.

topics.headline: emphatic final word belongs to a recurring denial formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on an emphatically marked passive raised predicate that echoes repeated resurrection-denial wording (17:49, 23:82, 37:16).
topics.reason: The preceding emphatic prefix is local, and the CRITICAL rows supply concrete cross-surah denial parallels.

topics.headline: closing cadence holds the questioned raisedness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens with questioned timing and closes with the long cadence of questioned raisedness.
topics.reason: The final position and plural ending support the CRITICAL closure and sound observations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "we die ... become dust and bones ... be raised" links م و ت, ت ر ب, ع ظ م, and ب ع ث.
baseline_models.mechanism: Death removes living force, while dust names loose matter and bones name the remaining hard frame; the passive بعث is then heard as the disputed reactivation of what has become inert and materially divided.

activation_trace.role: Loss of force and life supplies the discontinuity from which the objection begins.
Earth, dust, and loose residue supply the body's dispersed material pole.
Hard bone supplies the body's residual structural pole after life is gone.
Stirring a stationary thing from repose supplies the very transition the speakers deem implausible.

changed_reading.before: The speakers simply doubt resurrection after death.
changed_reading.after: They construct an impossibility argument from a one-way material sequence: living force vanishes, the body separates into loose substrate and hard remnant, and neither seems stirrable again.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperfect يَقُولُونَ under وَكَانُوا presents the interrogative as repeated speech, not a single startled question.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal recurrence combines with the القول branch of held doctrine and circulating report, turning interrogative form into a rehearsed position that a plural subject keeps present.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time frame both their continuing speech and the projected state of being dust.
Speech as belief or doctrine makes the question a maintained position rather than neutral information-seeking.
A saying spread among people supplies the social circulation by which the position persists.

changed_reading.before: The interrogative records an isolated intellectual doubt.
changed_reading.after: The interrogative is a repeatedly voiced creed: a collective keeps rehearsing material decomposition as its settled argument.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers are first constituted as a company under an encompassing side designation; their recurring saying can therefore function as speech that marks and maintains membership.

activation_trace.role: Circulating speech supplies the repeatable verbal marker of the group.
Companionship and abiding association supply the speakers' collective bond.
The leftward side literally names the category under which the company is placed.
Encompassment from several sides supplies an exploratory image of the label enclosing its members.

structural_cues: The doubled naming formula in 56:41 identifies the company before 56:47 reports what they used to say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, a repeated side-name, and recurring speech; I infer that shared speech reinforces belonging. Alternatively, the group label may be only an external verdict with no causal role in their saying.

changed_reading.before: A plurality happens to repeat the same skeptical claim.
changed_reading.after: The skeptical claim also works as group speech: repeating it helps articulate the identity of the company that voices it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers treat death's loss of force as effective escape into inert matter, but the preceding environment reverses every expected relief: penetration, heat, blackened cover, and a shade deprived of coolness and benefit all presuppose renewed exposure.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the presumed end of susceptibility.
Reactivation from stillness supplies renewed capacity for exposure.
A penetrating hot wind supplies invasive sensation rather than inert immunity.
Hot water supplies direct bodily heat and counters the imagined cessation of feeling.
Shade literally promises cover, creating the expectation that the next negations overturn.
Blackness, charcoal, and smoke convert protective cover into an obscuring material.
Coolness is explicitly withheld, cancelling shade's ordinary sensory function.
Noble generosity supplies the denied quality of beneficial shelter.

structural_cues: The sequence offers apparent shade and immediately negates both coolness and beneficence before the denial of raising is quoted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies postmortem conditions and the focus supplies death as loss of life; I infer that the sequence targets an assumed escape from sensation. Alternatively, the conditions may state consequence without answering the speakers' material logic.

changed_reading.before: The objection asks only how dead material could be reconstructed.
changed_reading.after: The objection also stakes a claim to postmortem insensibility, while the preceding scene answers with reactivated susceptibility in an environment where every form of relief is reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Temporal precedence, luxury that releases restraint, persistent resolve, and grave fault place the saying inside a conduct-belief loop: the denial protects a life already committed to remaining unaccountable.

activation_trace.role: Speech as doctrine supplies the belief component of the loop.
Precedence situates indulgence before the quoted denial and supplies the temporal direction.
Expansive ease that lets its possessor loose supplies the interest served by rejecting accountability.
Persistence and resolve supply the mechanism by which conduct hardens into a maintained stance.
Sin and constraining fault identify the conduct for which denial removes anticipated consequence.

structural_cues: Three consecutive clauses share the past habitual frame: they were indulged, they persisted, and they used to say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chronology and parallel habitual predicates; I infer an interest-bearing arrow from indulgent persistence to rehearsed denial. A live alternative is simple characterization: conduct and belief may correlate without one producing the other.

changed_reading.before: The speakers present a detached inference from bodily decay.
changed_reading.after: Their material argument is also motivated doctrine, rehearsed to preserve an already entrenched way of life from the prospect of account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The objection scales decomposition across ancestral time, and the reply answers on the same scale: first and last are gathered from dispersion into one bounded, known appointment. بعث becomes not an isolated restart but coordinated collection and dispatch.

activation_trace.role: Dust supplies the materially dispersed state that gathering must overcome.
Sending and directing the raised supplies coordinated movement toward an appointment.
Fatherhood and lineage extend the material objection beyond the present generation.
Priority and beginning push the challenge back to the earliest ancestors.
Lateness after the first supplies the opposite temporal endpoint included in the reply.
Joining what is scattered into a collected whole directly counters decomposition and temporal dispersion.
A fixed appointment supplies coordinated destination and temporal boundary.
A bounded duration supplies the common temporal container for the gathering.
Knownness replaces the speakers' indefinite improbability with a determined schedule.

structural_cues: The ancestral addendum in 56:48 enlarges the question; 56:49-50 answers with the inclusive pair "first and last" followed by a passive gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lineage, temporal endpoints, collection, and an appointed known time; I infer that collection answers both material scattering and historical distance. Alternatively, gathering may describe only juridical assembly, leaving the mechanics of restoration unstated.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is imagined as the unlikely revival of each isolated corpse.
changed_reading.after: The challenge concerns recovery across maximal material and generational dispersion, and the reply reframes بعث as a synchronized gathering of every temporal cohort to a fixed appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same plural subject moves from voicing denial to being named as deniers and then to eating, swallowing, filling bellies, and drinking without relief. Material embodiment, invoked as the reason consequence is impossible, becomes the medium through which consequence is experienced.

activation_trace.role: Speech as doctrine supplies the proposition that the subsequent bodily sequence answers.
Departure from right direction recategorizes the supposedly neutral question as misorientation.
Attributing denial or falsehood identifies the speech-act's adjudicated status.
Taking food into the body begins the answer as enacted embodiment rather than abstract argument.
Forced swallowing intensifies the body's role as the site of consequence.
Filling to the measure of a vessel turns the body into a bounded container of consequence.
The body's interior supplies the concrete vessel that receives what is swallowed.
Taking liquid continues the corporeal sequence and seeks relief through another material act.
Hot water reverses drinking's ordinary relief into added bodily exposure.
Unquenchable thirst closes the loop by making material intake unable to satisfy material need.

structural_cues: After the command to answer in 56:49, participial plurals carry the same addressees through gathering, naming, eating, filling, and drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a continuous plural subject and a chain of bodily acts; I infer a reversal in which embodiment becomes the answer to an argument based on bodily dissolution. Alternatively, the consumption scene may be consequence alone rather than a tailored rebuttal.

changed_reading.before: Dust and bones prove, for the speakers, that bodily consequence can no longer reach them.
changed_reading.after: Their appeal to matter is inverted: restored embodiment becomes precisely the conduit of consequence, with appetite, interior volume, heat, and thirst all made operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sending branch of بعث acquires a destination: the raised are dispatched toward a prepared reception whose time is a day of account and recompense. The apparent hospitality of نزل is made punitive by the preceding meal.

activation_trace.role: Sending a dispatched party supplies directed movement beyond mere reanimation.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest supplies the destination, here rendered as punitive reception.
A temporal span fixes the reception within an appointed day.
Account and recompense supply the juridical purpose of the dispatch.

structural_cues: The deictic "this" in 56:56 gathers the eating and drinking sequence into a named reception on the day of recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, prepared reception, and account; I infer a directed route from being raised to being received for judgment. Alternatively, بعث may retain only resurrection while destination is supplied independently by later clauses.

changed_reading.before: مبعوثون means only restored to life.
changed_reading.after: مبعوثون can additionally present the restored as a dispatched company, sent into an assigned reception whose governing purpose is account and recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for يَقُولُونَ, so it is form-distant and must not replace the ordinary speech reading. It remains anchored by the supplied split inventory and helps model how a repeated objection is borne upward and set in motion; downstream prose should mark it as phonetic-morphological activation, not lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus root ق و ل not only to root_001272 but also to root_001251 at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Bearing, rising, and setting out supply an exploratory image of the utterance carrying the objection into public motion.
Instability and movement supply the paradox that speech mobilizes a claim about matter that supposedly cannot move again.

changed_reading.before: Their saying merely communicates a static proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the act of saying bears and circulates the objection, setting social motion around a claim that denies renewed material motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses from the literal nouns dust and bones into secondary branches of poverty and self-magnification. It remains anchored in تُرَابًا and عِظَامًا and is sharpened by the immediately prior luxury cue; downstream prose should present it only as a contained social wordplay beneath the primary decomposition sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired predicates تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا carry packet branches for dust-bound need and self-magnifying pride alongside their literal material branches.

activation_trace.role: Poverty and abasement through contact with dust supply the lowered social pole of the pair.
Self-magnification and pride supply the elevated social pole that death renders brittle.
Unrestrained luxury supplies the prior social condition whose imagined permanence is undercut.

changed_reading.before: Dust and bones name only the physical residues of death.
changed_reading.after: As contained wordplay, the pair also collapses a luxurious, self-magnifying identity toward dust-level need while leaving pride as a hard but lifeless remnant.

strongest_changes: The habitual question becomes group-bound and conduct-protective doctrine rather than detached speculation.
Material and historical dispersion are answered by coordinated gathering at a known appointment.
Embodiment changes from the speakers' evidence against consequence into the medium of eating, heat, thirst, reception, and account.
summary.what_was_special: The trace links a tight material sequence in the focus to two surrounding reversals: scattered remains become a gathered company, and supposedly insensible matter becomes a body exposed to consequence. The supplied split mapping of ق و ل also preserves a form-distant image of the objection being carried into circulation.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from luxury and persistence to denial is abductive; the packet also permits simple correlation.
The sensory and consumption sequences may state consequences without directly answering the mechanics of restoration.
The ق ل ل activation and the dust-versus-greatness social reading are deliberately secondary and should not be lexicalized in translation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A spoken doctrine that treats decomposition as an obstacle.** `ق و ل` **B013** supplies belief or held doctrine, `م و ت` **B001** loss of vitality, `ت ر ب` **B001** soil and dust, `ع ظ م` **B005** bone, and `ب ع ث` **B001** rousing a still thing into motion. The question sequences life-loss, material residue, then denied reanimation. **Abductive move:** I infer that the speakers assume decomposition blocks agency; the packet later counters with creation processes. **Reading change:** the ayah exposes the hidden causal premise inside their question.

2. **Public talk that repeatedly circulates denial.** `ق و ل` **B007** supplies circulating talk or public report and `ك و ن` **B001** marks habitual past predication. The later labels `المكذبون` attach false-declaration to this discourse. **Abductive move:** I infer that repeated saying stabilizes group identity and persistence. **Reading change:** denial is social circulation, not only private doubt.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The semen, crop, rain, and fire sequence at 56:58–73 answered the hidden premise by displaying outcomes whose decisive causal stages exceed human action.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The denial treats bodily disassembly as evidence against renewed motion.** `ق و ل` (B001, uttered speech) frames `م و ت` (B001, loss of life), `ت ر ب` (B001, soil and dust), `ع ظ م` (B005, bone), and `ب ع ث` (B001, rousing a still thing into motion). Ayat 45–46 identify the speakers’ prior posture; ayat 48–52 widen the claim to ancestors, answer with universal gathering, and name the deniers. The packet supplies a sequence from death to residual materials to questioned reanimation; I infer that the argument mistakes changed material state for blocked agency. The ayah preserves their incredulous question while exposing its hidden premise.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:57–62 answers the premise through first creation, measured death, replacement, and unknown re-formation, while 56:87 turns claimed control into the failed test of returning life.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 Entrenched Denial Meets Scheduled Assembly
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A self-reinforcing stance of indulgence and denial is answered by the equally firm but external order of reanimation, collection, and appointed reckoning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The contrast is not simply belief versus disbelief; it is one fixation of will displaced by a stronger fixation of time, place, and bodily reassembly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Indulgence hardens into oath and assertion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Unrestricted luxury produces fixed resolve, breached obligation, and repeated false speech.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: luxury that releases its possessor from restraint `quranic:root_000179:B001/m01`; persistent resolve `quranic:root_000856:B002/m01`; grave sin and deviation `quranic:root_000359:B001/m01`; breach of an oath `quranic:root_000359:B002/m01`; articulated claim `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Ease is shown as a social condition that removes constraint, after which persistence becomes an operation: resolve is tied, obligation is broken, and the resulting assertion is held against contradiction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Oral publication and physical courier movement share one delivery architecture; the wish that unwelcome news be heard without reaching its subject isolates failed arrival as the reversal of successful transmission.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçekleşme ve bulunma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; yer, konum, üstlenme ve boyun eğme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme fiilinin belirli dil bilgisel ortamlarda sanma fiili gibi işletilmesini anlatır. Bu dal, gerçek söz söyleme eylemi değil, bir yargı veya varsayım kuran gramatik kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dil bilgisel sanma kullanımıdır; normal söz söyleme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel gramatik kullanımın dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Söyleme fiilinin bazı yapılarda sanmak veya varsaymak gibi işleyerek sonraki unsurları ona göre kurduğu dil bilgisel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, söyleme fiilinin sanma ve varsayma işleviyle kullanılmasıdır.
Kullanım özellikle soru yapısıyla sınırlanır, fakat aktarımda daha geniş bir lehçe uygulaması da anılır.
Kaynak içindeki lehçe notu, soru dışı kullanıma da uzanan özel bir genişleme bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, sanmak gibi işleyen söyleme kullanımını ve soru dışına uzanan lehçe notunu verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söyleme fiili gerçek konuşma değil, varsayım veya sanma yapısı kurduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gramatik işlevi ve sanma değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dil bilgisel açıklamada söyleme fiilinin varsayım değeri kazandığı bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sanma işlevini ve kullanım açıklamasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda epistemik zayıflık ve tahmin içeriği merkezdir; bu dalda dil bilgisel işleyiş merkezdir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.

branches.source_phrase_ar: العرب تجري تقول وحدها في الاستفهام مجرى تظن في العمل (sihah)؛ بنو سليم يجرون متصرف قلت في غير الاستفهام أيضا مجرى الظن (sihah)

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yükü taşımanın yanında yükselme, havalanma ve yüklenerek ayrılma anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: حمل الشيء واحتماله، وارتفاعه أو نهوضه، وارتحال القوم ظاعنين
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin yerinde duramamasını ve hareket sırasında çıkan sesi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kalp, deniz, diş, ağaç ve gök gürültüsü gibi alanlardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda ses, nesnenin kararsız hareketi ve sallanmasının sonucu olarak ortaya çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol çan, gök gürültüsü ve bulut gibi kaynaklardan gelen çınlama ve gürleme seslerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sallama, hareketten doğan ses ve aynı kökteki duygusal titreme karşılaştırmaları fiziksel hareket çekirdeğinin sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, canlıdaki gücün ve yaşamın sona ermesini çekirdek anlam olarak verir; ayrıca ölümün yaşamın karşıtı olduğunu ve yaşam türlerine göre ölüm türlerinin de ayrılabildiğini belirtir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu bileşenleri doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşamın sona ermesini anlatır; dilek, yalan veya okuma anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın anlamı hem de türemiş biçimlerle bir pekiştirme kalıbını içerir; kalıba özgü pekiştirme çekirdek ölüm anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Canlıdaki güç ve yaşamın sona ermesi, yani yaşam durumunun karşıtına geçmesidir. Ölüm türleri, söz konusu yaşam türlerine göre ayrılabilir.

facets.statement: Canlıdaki güç ve yaşam sona erer; bu durum yaşamın karşıtıdır.
Ölümün türleri, karşılık geldikleri yaşam türlerine göre ayrılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, ölümü yaşamın ve canlı gücünün sona ermesi olarak tanımlar. Toplu aktarım ayrıca bunun temel bir yaratılmış durum olduğunu ve farklı yaşam biçimlerine göre farklı ölüm türlerinden söz edilebildiğini bildirir.

concept_gloss.text: yaşamın ve canlı gücünün sona ermesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir canlının yaşam durumunun bütünüyle sona ermesini anlatan genel çekirdek karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşamın ve canlı gücünün sona ermesi biçimindeki çekirdek anlamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir canlının yaşamdan ayrıldığını bildiren yüklem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli canlıda yaşamın sona erdiğini doğal bir yüklemle eksiksiz aktarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yaşamın sona ermesini bütün canlılar için genel bir kavram olarak ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, ölen bir insanı gitme hareketiyle anlatan özel bir söyleyişe bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ölmek ve bu dünyadan göçüp gitmek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir insanın yaşamının sona ermesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğrudan ve genel ölüm kavramıdır; komşu dal ise insan ölümü için uzaklaşma görüntüsüne dayanan özel bir anlatımdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın kurucu sınırı, canlıdaki yaşamın sona ermesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, canlı olmayan şeylerin de tükenmesini, yok olmasını ve ortadan kaldırılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da önceden var olan bir durumun kesilmesi ve sona ermesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ölüm yaşam taşıyan varlığa bağlıdır; yok oluş ise yaşam koşulu aramadan bir şeyin tükenmesini veya ortadan kaldırılmasını da anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün komşu adayları karşılaştırıldı; yalnızca ölümle göçüp gitme ve genel yok oluş arasındaki sınırı açıklayan iki ilişki yayımlandı.
